q: A project team is comparing two suburban sites. Site A has bus service every 30 minutes; Site B has bus service every 90 minutes. All other factors being equal, which site earns more LEED LT points?

q: What is the purpose of a 'stormwater pollution prevention plan' (SWPPP) in a LEED project, and when must it be implemented?

logic: The SWPPP is the primary tool for complying with LEED's Construction Activity Pollution Prevention prerequisite.
